topics.display_title: Defence R&D: DRDO and Missile Systems

panels.title: Developer user producer map
ascii_lines: SERVICES -> articulate requirement and conduct user evaluation
DRDO -> design, develop, integrate and test
PRODUCTION AGENCY -> manufacture and quality assurance
SERVICES -> accept, induct, train and operate
RULE -> one institution cannot be substituted for another

panels.title: MSS subsystem chain
ascii_lines: DRDL / RCI / ASL / TBRL / ITR -> specialised roles
AIRFRAME + PROPULSION -> controlled flight
NAVIGATION + GUIDANCE + HOMING -> target solution
WARHEAD + LAUNCH + COMMAND SYSTEM -> weapon integration
RULE -> subsystem success is not integrated-system status

panels.title: Ballistic versus cruise
ascii_lines: BALLISTIC -> powered boost then largely ballistic path
CRUISE -> sustained powered and guided atmospheric flight
BALLISTIC DRIVER -> rocket boost and trajectory
CRUISE DRIVER -> air-breathing propulsion and aerodynamic control
TRAP -> range alone never determines the class

panels.title: Hypersonic taxonomy
ascii_lines: HYPERSONIC -> speed description, not one weapon class
BOOST-GLIDE -> rocket boost then manoeuvring glide
HYPERSONIC CRUISE -> sustained scramjet-type propulsion
BALLISTIC RE-ENTRY -> may also be hypersonic
RULE -> identify flight profile before status or capability

panels.title: Operational-role matrix
ascii_lines: SAM / AKASH -> surface launch against aerial threats
AAM / ASTRA -> aircraft launch against aerial threats
ATGM / NAG -> guided anti-armour role
PINAKA -> rocket-artillery land fires
RULE -> launch point, target and role travel together

panels.title: Weapon and platform split
ascii_lines: MISSILE -> guided weapon
LAUNCHER -> ground or shipboard launch equipment
AIRCRAFT / SHIP / SUBMARINE -> delivery platform
MULTI-PLATFORM CONFIGURATION -> does not merge categories
SPACE LAUNCH VEHICLE -> separate non-weapon function

panels.title: IGMDP lineage
ascii_lines: 1983 -> IGMDP begins
PRITHVI / TRISHUL / AKASH / NAG -> programme families
AGNI -> technology-demonstrator lineage
MARCH 2012 -> programme closure
RULE -> later systems require their own programme provenance

panels.title: BrahMos institutional card
ascii_lines: DRDO -> Indian joint-venture partner
NPOM -> Russian joint-venture partner
BRAHMOS AEROSPACE -> developer and producer entity
SYSTEM CLASS -> supersonic cruise missile
TRAP -> neither solo domestic nor ballistic

panels.title: Status ladder
ascii_lines: DEVELOPMENTAL TRIAL -> tested proposition
USER EVALUATION -> service-oriented validation
READY FOR INDUCTION -> recommendation, not induction
CONTRACT / DELIVERY / INDUCTION -> separate evidence
DEPLOYMENT -> requires its own official confirmation

panels.title: Air-defence system rail
ascii_lines: SENSORS -> detect and track
COMMAND-AND-CONTROL -> fuse, classify and assign
INTERCEPTORS -> engage selected threat classes
LOGISTICS / READINESS -> sustain coverage
TRAP -> announcement or one interceptor is not a shield

panels.title: Routed PYQ firewall
ascii_lines: STEALTH -> reduced observability, not invisibility
EXPLOSIVES -> category fact, not warhead detail
THAAD -> United States missile-defence system
FOBS -> fractional-orbit strike concept
RULE -> answer only the routed technical distinction

panels.title: Capability-claim firewall
ascii_lines: DEFINE -> weapon class and operational role
MAP -> developer, user, producer and platform
TRACE -> subsystem and test-to-service chain
LABEL -> announced, tested, contracted, inducted or deployed
VERIFY -> range, speed, stages, guidance and warhead officially
